inlines.v: SUBSERV'IENCE SUBSERV'IENCY, noun Instrumental use; use or operation that promotes some purpose. --The body, wherein appears much fitness, use and subserviency to infinite functions. There is a regular subordination and subserviency among all the parts to beneficial ends.
